id: \bBrandon: Hello again, \PN. This is Snowpoint Temple, where Regigigas lies. We recently had an incident with a hunter waking it up.
en: \bBrandon: Hello again, \PN. This is Snowpoint Temple, where Regigigas lies. We recently had an incident with a hunter waking it up.
it: \bBrandon: Ciao di nuovo, \PN. Questo è il Tempio di Nevepoli, dove riposa Regigigas. Di recente c'è stato un incidente: un cacciatore l'ha risvegliato.

id: \bBrandon: I found Regigigas, but it seems unfair for me to have too much power. How about you take it?
en: \bBrandon: I found Regigigas, but it seems unfair for me to have too much power. How about you take it?
it: \bBrandon: Ho trovato Regigigas, ma non mi sembra giusto avere troppo potere. Che ne dici di prenderlo tu?

id: \bYou don't have space for it.
en: \bYou don't have space for it.
it: \bNon hai spazio per lui.

id: \bNo worries. I'll hold onto it.
en: \bNo worries. I'll hold onto it.
it: \bNessun problema. Lo terrò io.

id: \bBrandon: Hello again, \PN. This is Snowpoint Temple.
en: \bBrandon: Hello again, \PN. This is Snowpoint Temple.
it: \bBrandon: Ciao di nuovo, \PN. Questo è il Tempio di Nevepoli.

id: \bMy ship is strong. It can even move through the icy waters.
en: \bMy ship is strong. It can even move through the icy waters.
it: \bLa mia nave è robusta. Riesce a muoversi persino nelle acque ghiacciate.

id: \rAbsol
en: \rAbsol
it: \rAbsol

id: \bI sense a problem at Iron Island. What could it be?
en: \bI sense a problem at Iron Island. What could it be?
it: \bPercepisco un problema sull'Isola Ferrosa. Cosa potrà essere?

id: \bUse this if you get too cold.
en: \bUse this if you get too cold.
it: \bUsa questo se hai troppo freddo.

id: \bOh wait, that only works on Pokémon.
en: \bOh wait, that only works on Pokémon.
it: \bOh, aspetta, funziona solo sui Pokémon.

id: \rChar
en: \rChar
it: \rChar

id: \rHmph. I can win if I want. I'm good at Contests.
en: \rHmph. I can win if I want. I'm good at Contests.
it: \rUff. Posso vincere quando voglio. Sono brava nelle Gare.

id: \rThe sun was in my eye. It messed me up.
en: \rThe sun was in my eye. It messed me up.
it: \rAvevo il sole negli occhi. Mi ha fatto sbagliare.

id: \bAboma
en: \bAboma
it: \bAboma

id: \rA visitor. What a rare surprise.
en: \rA visitor. What a rare surprise.
it: \rUn visitatore. Che rara sorpresa.

id: \bPaul: I can't believe I lost to you...
en: \bPaul: I can't believe I lost to you...
it: \bPaul: Non posso credere di aver perso contro di te...

id: \bBrandon: You did your best. Your Pokémon are trained very well, but you let your emotions betray you during the battle.
en: \bBrandon: You did your best. Your Pokémon are trained very well, but you let your emotions betray you during the battle.
it: \bBrandon: Hai dato il massimo. I tuoi Pokémon sono allenati molto bene, ma durante la lotta ti sei lasciato tradire dalle emozioni.

id: \bLearn to control your emotions and you can try again.
en: \bLearn to control your emotions and you can try again.
it: \bImpara a controllare le tue emozioni e potrai riprovarci.

id: \bPaul: Of course. Thank you sir.
en: \bPaul: Of course. Thank you sir.
it: \bPaul: Certo. Grazie, signore.

id: \bBrandon: Could you move aside, Paul? I believe I see an acquaintance of mine.
en: \bBrandon: Could you move aside, Paul? I believe I see an acquaintance of mine.
it: \bBrandon: Potresti spostarti, Paul? Mi pare di vedere una mia conoscenza.

id: \bBrandon: Hello again, \PN. So you're here challenging Gym Leaders. I'm here to try and see Regigigas.
en: \bBrandon: Hello again, \PN. So you're here challenging Gym Leaders. I'm here to try and see Regigigas.
it: \bBrandon: Ciao di nuovo, \PN. Quindi sei qui a sfidare i Capipalestra. Io sono qui per cercare di vedere Regigigas.

id: \bPaul, this is a former challenger of mine, and one of the few to win.
en: \bPaul, this is a former challenger of mine, and one of the few to win.
it: \bPaul, questo è un mio ex sfidante, e uno dei pochi ad aver vinto.

id: \bPaul: What?! You've beat Brandon! ...Alright, I'll admit you have some strength. Meet me at Lake Acuity later. I'll meet your team in a full battle.
en: \bPaul: What?! You've beat Brandon! ...Alright, I'll admit you have some strength. Meet me at Lake Acuity later. I'll meet your team in a full battle.
it: \bPaul: Cosa?! Hai battuto Brandon! ...E va bene, ammetto che hai una certa forza. Raggiungimi al Lago Arguzia più tardi. Affronterò la tua squadra in una lotta completa.

id: \bI know all the answers in class.
en: \bI know all the answers in class.
it: \bIn classe so sempre tutte le risposte.

id: \bI'm sorry. I assumed you weren't a good Trainer.
en: \bI'm sorry. I assumed you weren't a good Trainer.
it: \bScusa. Pensavo che non fossi un bravo Allenatore.

id: \rThere's a Beartic freezing everything. It would be best to stay away.
en: \rThere's a Beartic freezing everything. It would be best to stay away.
it: \rC'è un Beartic che congela tutto. Sarebbe meglio stargli alla larga.

id: \bHow are you not freezing?
en: \bHow are you not freezing?
it: \bCome fai a non congelare?

id: Snowpoint City\nCity of Snow
en: Snowpoint City\nCity of Snow
it: Nevepoli\nLa città della neve

id: \bLooker: Hello! I'm investigating Team Galactic. I've discovered you've encountered them a few times.
en: \bLooker: Hello! I'm investigating Team Galactic. I've discovered you've encountered them a few times.
it: \bBellocchio: Salve! Sto indagando sul Team Galassia. Ho scoperto che li hai incontrati un paio di volte.

id: \bYes... Yes, I see... Very fascinating. Thank you, that willl be quite helpful.
en: \bYes... Yes, I see... Very fascinating. Thank you, that willl be quite helpful.
it: \bSì... Sì, capisco... Davvero affascinante. Grazie, mi sarà di grande aiuto.

id: \bWho am I? My codename is Looker. I'm a detective working for the International Police.
en: \bWho am I? My codename is Looker. I'm a detective working for the International Police.
it: \bChi sono? Il mio nome in codice è Bellocchio. Sono un detective della Polizia Internazionale.

id: \bI've taken up enough of your day though. Thank you for the help.
en: \bI've taken up enough of your day though. Thank you for the help.
it: \bMa ti ho già rubato abbastanza tempo. Grazie per l'aiuto.

id: \bLooker: I've taken up enough of your day though. Thank you for the help.
en: \bLooker: I've taken up enough of your day though.  Thank you for the help.
it: \bBellocchio: Ma ti ho già rubato abbastanza tempo.  Grazie per l'aiuto.

id: \rDon't get too close to the water. It will freeze you right up.
en: \rDon't get too close to the water. It will freeze you right up.
it: \rNon avvicinarti troppo all'acqua. Ti congelerebbe all'istante.

id: \bI don't know if you can handle this move yet. Come back if you ever beat Candice.
en: \bI don't know if you can handle this move yet. Come back if you ever beat Candice.
it: \bNon so se sei già in grado di gestire questa mossa. Torna se riuscirai a battere Bianca.

id: \bThe Icicle Badge! You've earned the move, Block.
en: \bThe Icicle Badge! You've earned the move, Block.
it: \bLa Medaglia Ghiacciolo! Ti sei guadagnato la mossa Blocco.

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \bCome back anytime!
en: \bCome back anytime!
it: \bTorna quando vuoi!

id: \rHello there.
en: \rHello there.
it: \rSalve.

id: \rWe'll work harder on being a team.
en: \rWe'll work harder on being a team.
it: \rCi impegneremo di più per essere una squadra.

en: Snowpoint City Pokémon Gym Leader:\nCandice
